title: Final State Vector
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct Schrödinger state vector for the spin at time t.

title: Average Polarization
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the average polarization (expectation value of s_x) for t > 0.

title: Hamiltonian Formulation
description: Important Criteria: The student should derive the Hamiltonian for the system correctly.

title: Time Evolution
description: Important Criteria: The student must show the correct time evolution of the spin state using the Schrödinger equation.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as sign mistakes in the time evolution equations.

title: Expectation Value Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly compute the expectation value of s_x using the state vector.

title: Initial Conditions
description: Optional Criteria: The student should clearly state the initial conditions of the spin state.
